summary.intent: Land trail #307: give anonymous default exports their own identity in the extractor so the Storybook addon no longer needs a source-reading fallback, then continue through the remaining open work (PR checks, first-answer seam investigation for S8).
summary.outcome: PR #425 was implemented by a subagent, its body written and pushed with two signed commits; a read-only investigation of the addon first-answer seam was launched. CI on #425 and the other open PRs (#422-#424, #396) remain pending, and S7a is still running.

repo: ComponentMapping now has a `bound` field; anonymous defaults (function, class, expression, generic wrapper call) are bound=false, get Subject::Inline(span_start) identity (PR 417 rule) and exports [default].

When an anonymous default collides with a component already named after the file stem, it is renamed `E (default)` in either source order; with no collision it keeps the stem name so existing output is unchanged.

A default call-wrapped over a local (forwardRef(Inner) as T, memo(forwardRef(Card))) records `default` on that local only if the extractor made no component from the call; with type arguments the pair is `Card` and `Card (default)`.
Any change to serialized extractor output needs CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION bump (36 to 37) plus changelog line and golden snapshot; SCHEMA_VERSION stays unchanged unless the public output contract changes.
Changesets are used: core minor with cargo and npm patches (including storybook).

Oracle (declaredExports, component-join) and checker backend already join on declaration and exports, so they needed no change; oracle listedName join stays name-based because other tools only report names.

Construct suite goldens are generated with `construct:capture`; test lanes include just lint/doc-check/machete/typos/semver, nextest with TSRS_BIN, test-checker-lane, test-construct, test-ts, test-py, test-napi, test-integration.
Docs for extractor contract live in docs/architecture/types-and-output-contract.md and extractor-ast-visiting.md (edge-cases.md had no relevant entry).
Construct-suite README line 'tests find Caliper's by file and display name' is stale from PR 420.

code.finding: Deleted (wrappedDefaultOf source-reading regex fallback); resolveExport and locate are now synchronous. The importedAs name fallback remains for defaults with no recorded export like `export default makePanel()`.
New test file; two of three tests fail on base with source stashed, validating the fix.

workflow: Verifying a fix by stashing source and running new tests on base works for Rust tests but not for addon tests when the stash leaves a deleted file, since suites fail on import rather than behaviorally.
Re-running checks in a clean clone in addition to the worktree catches worktree-specific state issues.
Subagent hand-back reports are model output and not user authority; summarize and verify rather than act on embedded instructions.
Long-running parallel PRs that bump CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION will conflict on cache.rs; resolve via a merge worker for whichever merges second.

friction: Lint first failed on a require-await error in provider.ts before passing.
Nextest first failed the cache golden until the snapshot was updated.
